name: Jacob Cook
tagline: Detection & security automation engineer · MS Cybersecurity @ WGU · Security+, CySA+, PenTest+, SecurityX, CSIE · SIEM, detection, identity, cloud, SOAR
heroSubtitle: Detection engineering, automation, and blue-team security.
bio: Detection-focused security engineer with a BS in Computer Science and an MS in Cybersecurity in progress at WGU. I ship detection and automation work across SIEM, identity, and cloud: Sigma-style detection packs, Okta identity detections, SOAR-style orchestration, Terraform and Azure auditing, network behavior tooling, and SOC-style Wazuh labs. Based in California. Outside of work I enjoy camping, mountain biking, and time with my dogs.
targetRoles: Open to: Detection Engineer, SOC Analyst, Security Automation Engineer, Threat Detection Analyst, Cybersecurity Analyst — Sacramento or remote.
